title: Open warehouses and ship (fixed-charge network)
prompt:
Three warehouses can supply four stores. Opening warehouse i costs 100, 150, 120 per month (i = 1, 2, 3) and it can then ship at most 60, 90, 80 units in total. Store demands (units, met exactly) are 30, 25, 40, 35 for stores 1 to 4. The cost per unit shipped from warehouse i to store j is:
- w1: 4, 6, 9, 5
- w2: 5, 3, 4, 7
- w3: 8, 5, 3, 4
A warehouse that stays closed ships nothing. Minimise the total of opening and shipping costs.
Name the variables `open_i` (0-1) and `ship_i_j` (units, continuous), for example `open_2` and `ship_1_4`.

Report values at the full precision the solver returns.

End your final message with one line of the form
ANSWER: {"status": "<solution status string>", "objective": <number>, "plan": {"<variable name>": <value>, ...}}
where `plan` lists every decision variable named above by exactly the name given (zeros may be left out), and `status` is "Optimal" when the solver proves optimality.
